blocks.en: HOPE. Expectation; looking and waiting for. God its Source and Giver, by grace: Ps. 71:5. Thou art my hope, O Lord God. Ps. 39:7. My hope is in Thee. Ps. 146:5. Happy is he . . . whose hope is in the Lord his God. Ps. 147:11. Those that hope in His mercy. 1 Tim. 1:1. The Lord Jesus Christ, which is our hope. 2 Thes. 2:16. Good hope through grace. Ps. 119:114. I hope in Thy word. Allied with faith, love, patience, joy and peace: 1 Cor. 13:13. Now abideth faith, hope, love. Rom. 15:13. Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, in the power of the Holy Ghost. 1 Pet. 1:21. Your faith and hope might be in God. Rom. 5:4. Patience worketh experience (evidence by testing); and experience, hope. Rom. 15:4. That we through patience and comfort of the Scriptures might have hope. Hoping and waiting are interchangeably used in the Psalms: Ps. 130:5. I wait for the Lord . . . and in His word do I hope. Rom. 8:25. If we hope for that we see not, then do we with patience wait for it. The helmet of the believer's panoply: 1 Thes. 5:8. And for an helmet, the hope of salvation.
blocks.zh: 盼望。期待；仰望等候。神本乎恩，是盼望的源头与赐予者：诗篇 71:5 —— 主耶和华啊，你是我所盼望的。39:7 —— 我的指望在乎你。146:5 —— 仰望耶和华他神的，这人便为有福。147:11 —— 盼望他慈爱的人。提摩太前书 1:1 —— 我们的盼望基督耶稣。帖撒罗尼迦后书 2:16 —— 因恩典……的盼望（英译：借恩典赐美好的盼望）。诗篇 119:114 —— 我甚仰望你的话语。与信、爱、忍耐、喜乐、平安联盟：哥林多前书 13:13 —— 如今常存的有信、有望、有爱。罗马书 15:13 —— 但愿使人有盼望的神，因信将诸般的喜乐平安充满你们的心，使你们借着圣灵的能力大有盼望。彼得前书 1:21 —— 叫你们的信心和盼望都在于神。罗马书 5:4 —— 忍耐生老练（受试验而得的凭据），老练生盼望。15:4 —— 叫我们因圣经所生的忍耐和安慰，可以得着盼望。诗篇中『盼望』与『等候』互用：诗篇 130:5 —— 我等候耶和华……我也仰望他的话。罗马书 8:25 —— 但我们若盼望那所不见的，就必忍耐等候。信徒全副军装中的头盔：帖撒罗尼迦前书 5:8 —— 把得救的盼望当作头盔戴上。

grammar.note: Now the God of hope fill you …：祈愿虚拟——动词原形 fill（但愿……充满你们）。
Patience worketh experience; and experience, hope：顶真＋后半省略动词（忍耐生老练，老练生盼望）；then do we with patience wait：do 强调式＋状语插入。

blocks.en: Fruits or effects: Rom. 5:5. Hope maketh not ashamed. 1 John 3:3. Every one that hath this hope set on Him purifieth himself, even as He is pure. Heb. 6:19. Which hope we have as an anchor of the soul, both sure and steadfast. Jer. 17:7. Blessed is the man . . . whose hope the Lord is. Rom. 12:12. Rejoicing in hope. Lam. 3:26. It is good that a man should hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the Lord. Its sublime and blessed end: Rom. 8:24. We are saved by hope. Col. 1:27. Christ in you, the hope of glory. Col. 1:5. The hope which is laid up for you in the heavens. 1 Pet. 1:3, 4. Begotten us again unto a living hope, by the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead, unto an inheritance . . . reserved in heaven. The believer encouraged and urged to hope: Ps. 42:5, 11. Hope thou in God. Zech. 9:12. Turn you to the stronghold, ye prisoners of hope. 1 Pet. 1:13. Set your hope perfectly on the grace that is to be brought unto you at the revelation of Jesus Christ. Heb. 6:11. Show diligence unto the fullness of hope, even to the end. 1 Pet. 3:15. Ready always to give answer to every man that asketh you a reason concerning the hope that is in you. See Waiting on God; Thirsting for God.
blocks.zh: 盼望的果子与果效：罗马书 5:5 —— 盼望不至于羞耻。约翰一书 3:3 —— 凡向他有这指望的，就洁净自己，像他洁净一样。希伯来书 6:19 —— 我们有这指望，如同灵魂的锚，又坚固又牢靠。耶利米书 17:7 —— 倚靠耶和华、以耶和华为可靠的，那人有福了。罗马书 12:12 —— 在指望中要喜乐。耶利米哀歌 3:26 —— 人仰望耶和华，静默等候他的救恩，这原是好的。盼望崇高蒙福的归宿：罗马书 8:24 —— 我们得救是在乎盼望。歌罗西书 1:27 —— 基督在你们心里成了有荣耀的盼望。1:5 —— 是为那给你们存在天上的盼望。彼得前书 1:3-4 —— 借耶稣基督从死里复活，重生了我们，叫我们有活泼的盼望，可以得着……存留在天上的基业。劝勉催促信徒去盼望：诗篇 42:5, 11 —— 应当仰望神。撒迦利亚书 9:12 —— 你们被囚而有指望的人，都要转回保障。彼得前书 1:13 —— 专心盼望耶稣基督显现的时候所带来给你们的恩。希伯来书 6:11 —— 显出这样的殷勤，使你们有满足的指望，一直到底。彼得前书 3:15 —— 有人问你们心中盼望的缘由，就要常作准备……回答各人。参主题词条：等候神；渴慕神。

grammar.note: Every one that hath this hope / every man that asketh you：凡有这指望的／凡问你们的。
ye prisoners of hope：呼格——『被囚而有指望的人』（撒迦利亚名句）。
Hope maketh not ashamed：不用 do 的否定（盼望不至于羞耻）。

vocab_table.def: n. 全副军装（盼望＝头盔）【GRE】
n. 锚（盼望如灵魂的锚，来 6:19）
n. 保障（被囚而有指望的人当转回保障）
